content.json:
# Sentinel Usage Velocity
Hourly ingestion velocity, anomaly detection on the last hour, and end-of-month projections based on the last 24 hours and last 1 hour.

content.query:
let billable = tobool('{BillableOnly}');
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {Lookback}
| where billable == false or IsBillable == true
| summarize MB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart
content.title: Hourly ingestion (MB/hour)
Hourly ingestion with anomaly baseline
Detected anomalies
Last hour vs 8-day hourly baseline

content.json:
## End-of-month projections
Projection = ingestion to date this month + (per-hour velocity x remaining hours in month).

content.title: End-of-month projections
Cumulative MTD ingestion vs projections (GB)

content.query:
let billable = tobool('{BillableOnly}');
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {Lookback}
| where billable == false or IsBillable == true
| summarize MB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), DataType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart
content.title: Hourly ingestion by DataType
Per-table last hour vs 24h average
